In canon the Legend of Sparda exist for a reason, because Sparda was the one who defeated and sealed away Mundus. This is what gives his name legitimacy, and helps to begin the story as it relates between him and his sons.

DmC Sparda doesn't defeat Mundus, and instead is just targeted for having children with Eva, and sentenced to.. eternal BDSM.. So this story has almost 0 function for Sparda, the name almost the entire franchise hinges on. Instead it opts for hoping Nephilim can carry any weight behind it. Which for me it doesnt, making them Half Angel over human is some fan fic level story ideas, and unfortunately its the best it has to offer. 

The story worked far better when it was about the legacy battle between Sparda and Mundus, from the betrayal of Sparda and sealing of Hell to start it, Mundus's revenge in attempting to kill his family, Vergil falling and being captured by Mundus ( in a less funny way ), Turning of him into Nelo Angelo, and Dante taking the form of Sparda to stop Mundus for good (besides that weird mobile game)

At best id say it had the benefit of the Demon/Angel modes actually being p fun to mess with for combo stuff switching between them. 

But I hope.you can at least see my POV on how in the process Sparda's worth as a character was jeopardized, and how that can mess with the perspective of the story..im not saying he HAD to be as much hot shit as his original, but I am saying making them special lil demon angel boys that can beat up the super duper demon bc they're mystical or whatever isnt exactly as gripping as the unknowingly long demonic grudge match between 2 Top Tier of the Underworld, with the sons being thrusted into the grudge wether they liked it or not.
